n8n-drive-contabil.nome: Document Search and Delivery API for an Accounting Archive (n8n)

sysadmin-gcp: Built a document search and delivery API on self-hosted n8n (Docker) over an accounting firm's Google Drive: 15 workflows, 14 Data Tables and 53 webhook routes over 163,738 indexed folders.

Authenticated Drive access with a Google Cloud service account (IAM) in a dedicated project: the shared quota of a third-party app ran out three times in one day, while the dedicated project allows about 12,000 calls per minute.
Monitored CPU, memory and event-loop lag through the Prometheus-format metrics exposed by n8n itself (/metrics); 219 test cases cover the behavior.

vtiger-crm.nome: Recovery and Operation of a Production vtiger CRM

sysadmin-gcp: Recovered a vtiger CRM 8.4 installation (PHP, MySQL and Apache) whose menu came up broken: the cause was in the database, where the vtiger_app2tab table had 11 links instead of 38, with no way to fix it from the UI.
Wrote 3,291 lines of idempotent command-line PHP scripts, with a backup before any write, dry-run mode, cron and permission checks, and a dedicated exit code for monitoring.
Fixed the dashboard schema, which lacked three columns used by the code, and consolidated everything into a single post-install patch.
